about: The exact versions of the held packages (Chromium, the kernel, Wi-Fi firmware) a radar may install, tested on ring 0 first. os-update.py installs them; see #73. Empty: every radar keeps the versions it has.
tested_on: ring 0 (RDU), 2026-10-13: kernel 6.18.34 to 6.18.50 on trial, firmware with it. Chromium 156 goes to ring 0 on trial from 2026-11-15 and has not passed yet (154 ran there from 10-12). chromium-sandbox is pinned at the same build as the other three: the archive offered it at that version on 2026-11-15; ring 0 does not have that package installed, and os-update.py leaves alone a package a radar does not have
